text: Astra design decision: move five portable view files and three backend hosts/tests to optional neuroim4s.view modules; delete alias-only Colorizer.scala and import Intaglio directly. Preserve d553 Intaglio pin, OpenJFX21.0.5 Provided, override coherence, all fixtures/export schemas. Provider source worker owns only new modules, parent owns both builds/Root deletion/docs/CI. No parallel sbt; parent runs gates. Required actual browser and bounded native drawing evidence retained. No core display dependency or compatibility facade.
